title: The Dark Tower
notes: Lead: "the film combines various elements from the eight-novel series, mostly from the first and third volumes ... The film is also a canonical sequel to the novels." Kept as its own continuity (rule: never merge) despite the 'canonical sequel' wording. Runtime 95 minutes. A planned sequel and an Amazon TV series were not made (Amazon "decided not to move forward with the pilot" in January 2020); Mike Flanagan series announced December 2022 (no release) - excluded.

release.note: Wikipedia: "The Dark Tower premiered at the Museum of Modern Art in New York City on July 31, 2017, and was theatrically released in the United States by Sony Pictures Releasing on August 4, 2017."
